name: all-systems-go
description: The enrichment pack for your ContextOS — named for airCFO's All Systems Go series on the startup back-office stack. Connects the rest of that stack (Stripe, Ramp, Mercury; each read-only with your own login) and adds cross-system workflows that read your ContextOS first: runway & burn, revenue reconciliation, board metrics — plus meta-skills to author and refine your own. Install finance-contextos first. Unofficial — not affiliated with or endorsed by Stripe, Ramp, Mercury, or Anthropic.
